Definition: the south; poet. the south wind
BiblicalUsage: The south is the direction of the wind and the quarter of the land, and the word gathers the map of Israel into one. The south wind brings heat and the rain, the southern border runs to the desert, and the blessing of Naphtali is to possess the west and the south. The chambers of the temple face south, and the prophet walks the south side of the house of God.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the south reminds us that God's land has directions, and every quarter of it belongs to Him. The south wind comes when God sends it, and the land that waits for rain waits on Him.
